# polaris_semantic_model_grant (Resource)

Grants a semantic-model-level privilege to a Polaris catalog role. Requires the `ENABLE_SEMANTIC_MODELS` feature on the server, and the semantic model must exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_semantic_model_grant" "analysts_read_revenue" {
  catalog             = "lakehouse"
  catalog_role        = "analysts"
  namespace           = ["sales"]
  semantic_model_name = "revenue"
  privilege           = "SEMANTIC_MODEL_READ"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The name of the catalog. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `catalog_role` (String) The name of the catalog role receiving the grant. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace path as an ordered list of components. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `privilege` (String) The semantic-model-level privilege to grant (e.g. SEMANTIC_MODEL_READ, SEMANTIC_MODEL_WRITE). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `semantic_model_name` (String) The name of the semantic model. Changing this forces a new resource.
